caption: The drawing depicts a single round-bottomed bowl with a reddish-brown exterior and a silvery-gray interior. The bowl has a smooth, curved surface and sits on a small, circular base. The rim of the bowl is slightly irregular and wavy, following the contours of the handles. The background is a plain, light beige color, and there are no other objects present in the image. title: Copper Bowl
